parts.t: Beautifully updated and move-in ready, this 5-bedroom home sits on a spacious 6,736 sq. ft. lot in a quiet, central neighbourhood. Features a fully renovated 2-bedroom legal suite, a stylish kitchen with quartz counters and backsplash, new lighting, flooring, sump pump, and concrete work. Enjoy central A/C, two gas fireplaces, a 36” six-burner gas range, and a new gas line to the backyard—perfect for entertaining. Fully fenced yard with RV/boat access. Walking distance to schools, parks, and shopping.
